entries.heading: PROHIBITION RELATING TO FOREIGN ENTITIES OF CONCERN
ancestors: TITLE XCIX—CREATING HELPFUL INCENTIVES TO PRODUCE SEMICONDUCTORS FOR AMERICA
entries.text:
SEC. 9907. PROHIBITION RELATING TO FOREIGN 
                          ENTITIES OF CONCERN.

    None of the funds authorized to be appropriated to carry out this 
subtitle may be provided to a foreign entity of concern.
